item.title: Methodology

item.description: This report explores the posting activity and topics discussed by health and wellness influencers on social media. It is based on an analysis of 535,512 Instagram, TikTok and YouTube posts published by 6,334 influencers from Feb. 1 to April 30, 2026. item.title: Which Health and Wellness Influencers Talk About Medical Topics? Mostly Healthcare Professionals
item.dc:creator: Joy Li
item.description: Influencers who describe themselves as healthcare professionals tend to post much more often about topics like medical conditions, mental health or treatments requiring the supervision of a doctor.

item.title: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
item.dc:creator: Joy Li
item.description: Just over half of health and wellness content on social media focuses on healthy living, while about a third discusses medical topics. And 38% of posts have a product or service promotion.
